snapshot.text: Public health networks under the Ministry of Health and Medical Education, with broad insurance coverage but high out-of-pocket costs and unpaid debts. The 2026 war with the US and Israel included attacks on health facilities, and the government frames the health system as a pillar of national resilience.

minister.name: Mohammad-Reza Zafarghandi

priorities.title: Family Physician Program

priorities.title: Attacks on the health sector
